name: Else
mechanism: NoRun token; branches are wired by Build::Linker at build time (else-if chains supported)
limitations: Only valid directly after an if/else-if block; a stray Else is a build-time SyntaxException

mechanism: NoRun tokens named "{" and "}"; Linker opens/closes ConditionalSection
limitations: Unbalanced braces are build-time errors (linker.cr:34,38); no other block scoping

name: Break
mechanism: Linker repoints Break.next to after the loop; run() calls innermost Loop#finish to close files
limitations: Breaks outside a loop raise "Trying to BREAK without a LOOP" (break.cr:10)

name: Continue
mechanism: Linker repoints Continue.next to the loop head; run() returns true
limitations: Same linker constraint as Break

name: Return
mechanism: Thread#return pops the cmd stack (gosub/function-less model)
limitations: Return from the top level ends the thread only

name: Exit
mechanism: Thread#exit(code) clears stack, records exit code
limitations: Exit code of the process is set by Runner#exit_app, not Thread#exit

name: GoSub
mechanism: Pushes the label's cmd onto the thread stack (labels resolved at run time)
limitations: Unknown label is a runtime exception that kills the thread (thread.cr:197)

name: GoTo
mechanism: Replaces the top of the thread stack with the label's cmd
limitations: Unknown label = runtime exception (thread.cr:203)

name: IfEqual
mechanism: IfComparison: numeric compare when both operands parse as float, else String#==
limitations: No case/string-case mode; trailing spaces are not trimmed (AutoTrim absent)

name: Loop
mechanism: LoopType enum (Endless/Count/Files/Read/Parse); Linker builds a LoopConditional
limitations: Count is Int32; A_LoopFileTimeCreated and A_LoopFileAttrib are deliberately not set (loop.cr:86,88)

name: SetEnv
mechanism: Runner#set_user_var stores a Bytes slice under a downcased key
limitations: Setting a built-in variable name is silently ignored (runner.cr:271); "Clipboard" is intercepted (runner.cr:268)

name: Sleep
mechanism: Fiber sleep(val.milliseconds)
limitations: Sleep -1 (wait forever) is not special-cased; fractional values accepted

name: FileCopy
mechanism: Dir.glob(source) then File.copy; flag 0 = do not overwrite, else delete+copy
limitations: No FileCopyDir semantics; directories skipped (file-copy.cr:11); no recursive copy

name: SetTimer
mechanism: Tasker.every(period) creates a thread per tick; skips tick if the previous timer thread is still running
limitations: Default period when "On" without period = 250 ms (set-timer.cr:13); no "Run once" semantics

name: WinActivate
mechanism: libxdo window.activate! + focus! + raise!
limitations: One attempt only; the 6-tries/60ms retry of Win AHK is a TODO in code (win-activate.cr:9); needs a WM

name: MsgBox
mechanism: GTK3 MessageDialog created on the GTK worker thread via Gtk.act; response via Channel
limitations: Headless prints text only (msg-box.cr:25); options bitmask subset (buttons, 4 icons, always-on-top); Task_Modal unused (gtk.cr:119); Escape returns Cancel even when not deletable (gtk.cr:150)

name: Gui
mechanism: Parser rewrites "Gui, sub ..." into the Gui<Sub> command classes; windows are GTK3 Gtk::Window on one worker thread
limitations: Subcommands exist only where a GuiXxx class exists (Add/Show/Submit/Cancel/Hide/Destroy/Color/Scroll/Option/Control); no AutoSize, no Center, no GuiSize/GuiEscape dispatch beyond GuiClose

name: SendRaw
mechanism: libxdo xdo_type (XTEST) after saving/clearing/restoring active modifiers
limitations: Special characters (e.g. the section sign) are documented as unreliable; a second key-up is emitted when the hotkey key itself is in the text (send-raw.cr:19-24)

name: #Persistent
mechanism: Parser sets RunnerSettings#persistent
limitations: Only honored at parse time; cannot be toggled later

name: ExitApp
mechanism: Runner#exit_app calls ::exit(code)
limitations: No OnExit hook exists (no OnExit command; only at_exit in runner.cr:114)

name: EnvAdd
mechanism: Float arithmetic, integer result when both operands look integral; optional TimeUnits adds Time::Span to a YYYYMMDDHH24MISS date
limitations: TimeUnits other than d/s/m/h yields empty string; invalid date yields empty string (env-add.cr:14-44)

name: EnvSub
mechanism: Negates the operand and delegates to EnvAdd
limitations: Same TimeUnits/date limits as EnvAdd

name: EnvMult
mechanism: Float multiply; int result if both operands look integral
limitations: Non-numeric operands become 0

name: EnvDiv
mechanism: Float divide; int result if both operands look integral
limitations: Division by zero produces "Inf"/"NaN" strings rather than ErrorLevel

name: ControlSendRaw
mechanism: libxdo window.type on the matched window (window-scoped XTEST)
limitations: The Control (ClassNN) argument is ignored (_control); text still goes to the focused client of that window

name: IfWinExist/IfWinNotExist
mechanism: Window search via libxdo (title/class/visible/desktop); sets thread last-found window
limitations: Title match is a leading substring (libxdo window_name regex), not AHK regex; hidden windows only when DetectHiddenWindows is on

name: SetWorkingDir
mechanism: Dir.cd + A_WorkingDir built-in
limitations: Changes the whole process CWD (all threads)

name: FileAppend
mechanism: File.write(mode: "a"); with no filename appends to the Loop,Read output file
limitations: No binary mode, no "*" (stdout) target, no wildcard destination

name: Hotkey
mechanism: Hotkeys#add_or_update: ungrab/re-grab through XGrabKey/XGrabButton; grab set re-applied on active-window change
limitations: Options B (buffer) and T (max threads) are parsed but unused (hotkey.cr:21-29); no ListHotkeys/KeyHistory

name: Send
mechanism: libxdo keys_raw with per-key Charcodemap (XTEST); mouse buttons via xdo mouse_down/up; modifiers saved and restored
limitations: Documented: cannot send a key that is physically down; RButton->LButton remap fails; {blind} is a workaround; sending the hotkey's own key needs an extra key-up (send.cr:60-73)

name: ControlSend
mechanism: window.keys_raw per key combination (window-scoped XTEST)
limitations: Control argument is ignored; no SetKeyDelay application guarantee across windows

name: #Hotstring
mechanism: Parser stores default hotstring options and rewrites "#Hotstring EndChars" into Hotstring end-char set
limitations: Only EndChars and a global option prefix are recognized

name: Menu
mechanism: GTK StatusIcon tray menu: Add (with label/priority), Icon, NoIcon, Tip
limitations: MenuName must be "TRAY" (menu.cr:6); no GUI menu bars, no submenus, no Delete/Default/MenuGetHandle

name: FileCreateDir
mechanism: Dir.mkdir_p
limitations: ErrorLevel 0/1 only

name: FileDelete
mechanism: Dir.glob + File.delete
limitations: Directories are not removed (raises, caught as ErrorLevel 1)

name: IfMsgBox
mechanism: Compares the last MsgBox response string (downcased) with the argument
limitations: Only tracks the most recent MsgBox of the current thread

name: #SingleInstance
mechanism: flock on "/tmp/ahk_x11 <binary+argv>.lock"; HUP the old pid; Prompt uses a GTK MsgBox
limitations: Identity is the binary path plus ARGV (runner.cr:343); a stale lock/proc is not cleaned on exit (runner.cr:373)

name: Edit
mechanism: Runs "gtk-launch <xdg-mime default text/plain> <script>"
limitations: Only opens the main script file, via the desktop's default text editor; no line number, no editor selection

name: FileReadLine
mechanism: Line-by-line scan of the file counting to LineNum
limitations: No negative line numbers (EOF relative)

name: FileSelectFile
mechanism: GTK FileChooserDialog (Open or Save when Options contains S)
limitations: Filter, multiple-selection and most Options are ignored; multi-file returns one name; blocks on a Channel

name: FileSelectFolder
mechanism: GTK FileChooserDialog in SelectFolder mode
limitations: Options ignored

name: FileSetAttrib
mechanism: chmod with +,-,^ and X/N letters
limitations: Only X (executable) and N are honoured; R/A/S/H/O/T are parsed and dropped (file-set-attrib.cr:24-25)

name: FileSetTime
mechanism: File.touch for the modification time; default = now
limitations: Only WhichTime "M" is implemented (file-set-time.cr:19-21); C and A are ignored

name: IfNotEqual
mechanism: IfComparison with !=
limitations: Same numeric/string heuristic as IfEqual

name: If var [not] between
mechanism: Splits the operand on " and ", numeric compare when all three parse as float
limitations: Requires the literal " and " separator; no case/format options

name: IfExist/IfNotExist
mechanism: Dir.glob(pattern) non-empty (IfNotExist: empty)
limitations: Glob semantics, not the Windows wildcard rules; hidden files included

name: IfGreater/IfGreaterOrEqual
mechanism: IfComparison with > and >=
limitations: Positional string compare when not numeric

name: IfInString/IfNotInString
mechanism: Downcased String#includes?
limitations: Always case-insensitive (StringCaseSense is unimplemented)

name: IfLess/IfLessOrEqual
mechanism: IfComparison with < and <=
limitations: Positional string compare when not numeric

name: IfWinActive/IfWinNotActive
mechanism: Compares the matched window to libxdo active_window (EWMH _NET_ACTIVE_WINDOW)
limitations: Compares window ids only; no "A" special handling differences

name: IniDelete
mechanism: ini shard: parse, delete section/key, rebuild whole file
limitations: Rewriting loses comments and key order

name: IniRead
mechanism: ini shard parse; returns Default ("ERROR" when omitted)
limitations: Section/key names case-sensitive; no quoting rules

name: IniWrite
mechanism: ini shard build with space: true
limitations: Rewrites the file, losing comments/order; no quoting of values

name: Loop (files & folders)
mechanism: File::Util.match (Dir.glob, include-folders, recurse) fills @files; A_LoopFile* built-ins
limitations: A_LoopFileTimeCreated and A_LoopFileAttrib are not set (loop.cr:86,88); FilePattern is a glob, not AHK wildcard

name: Loop (read file contents)
mechanism: File#gets per iteration; optional second argument is an append output file
limitations: No binary mode; implements A_LoopReadLine

name: MouseClick
mechanism: libxdo move_mouse + mouse_down/mouse_up (XTEST); D/U and R supported
limitations: Speed param (arg 5) is ignored: libxdo has no step support (mouse-move.cr:6-14)

name: Pause
mechanism: Runner#pause_thread flips Thread#paused; the clock fiber skips paused threads; tray icon shows a loading symbol
limitations: Pauses "the underlying thread" by index (runner.cr:392), not per-thread; Pause, , 1 (thread priority) unsupported

name: Reload
mechanism: Spawns a new process with the same ARGV and exits
limitations: No SIGHUP state preservation; chdir to the initial working dir (runner.cr:196-200)

name: StringGetPos
mechanism: Regex.escape + String#index/rindex on a downcased text
limitations: Always case-insensitive; ErrorLevel is 0/1 (found/not) rather than AHK's 1-when-not-found contract

name: StringLeft
mechanism: String#[0, count]
limitations: Count < 1 leaves the output variable untouched

name: StringLen
mechanism: String#size (characters, UTF-8 aware)
limitations: No LengthMax/byte semantics

name: StringLower
mechanism: String#downcase, titleize for T
limitations: Locale-independent Cocoa/Unicode casing

name: StringMid
mechanism: String#[start, count] with 1-based adjustment
limitations: The L (by-reference output variable) parameter is not implemented

name: StringReplace
mechanism: Regex.escape + String#sub/gsub, always case-insensitive
limitations: ErrorLevel is 0/1 (changed/unchanged), not the replacement count

name: StringRight
mechanism: String#[size-count, size]
limitations: Count > length clamps to whole string

name: StringUpper
mechanism: String#upcase, titleize for T
limitations: Locale-independent

name: Suspend
mechanism: Runner#suspend ungrab/re-grab every hotkey; hotkeys whose first line is Suspend stay exempt
limitations: Tray icon switches to a keyboard symbol; no per-hotkey exemption syntax (#IfWinActive absent)

name: URLDownloadToFile
mechanism: Crystal HTTP::Client.get, then File.write
limitations: No resume, proxy, user agent, timeout or TLS options; whole body buffered in memory

name: WinClose
mechanism: libxdo window.quit! (sends WM_DELETE_WINDOW)
limitations: SecondsToWait argument is deleted and ignored (win-close.cr:8)

name: WinGetPos
mechanism: libxdo window.location and window.size
limitations: Outputs empty strings when no window matches (win-get-pos.cr:20-25)

name: WinKill
mechanism: libxdo window.kill! (XKillClient)
limitations: SecondsToWait ignored; no graceful fallback

name: WinMaximize
mechanism: EWMH _NET_WM_STATE add maximized_horz + maximized_vert
limitations: Requires an EWMH-compliant WM

name: WinMinimize
mechanism: libxdo window.minimize! (WM_CHANGE_STATE IconicState)
limitations: Requires ICCCM-compliant WM

name: WinMove
mechanism: libxdo window.move and window.resize
limitations: No "ScreenSize"/relative-to-window semantics; both w and h required to resize (win-move.cr:17)

name: WinRestore
mechanism: EWMH remove maximized_horz/vert
limitations: Does not un-minimize (WinRestore of an iconified window is a no-op)

name: MouseGetPos
mechanism: libxdo mouse_location; optional Control under cursor via AT-SPI accessible_at_point
limitations: Control output needs accessibility; coordinates via CoordMode

name: MouseMove
mechanism: libxdo move_mouse (absolute or relative)
limitations: Speed is not implemented, needs xdotool step support (mouse-move.cr:6-14)

name: GetKeyState
mechanism: PressedKeys keeps an 8-slot list of currently down keysyms fed by Xtst Record events; returns D/U
limitations: Only D/U; no T (toggle) mode, no joystick/button distinction; state comes from the recorded event stream, not XQueryKeymap

name: KeyWait
mechanism: Registers a key listener, waits on a Channel with optional T timeout; D option
limitations: No L (logical state) option; waits on keysym, not keycode

name: ControlClick
mechanism: AT-SPI: find_descendant then do_action (name-priority list) or Selection select as fallback
limitations: No pointer click; WhichButton/ClickCount options mostly ignored (count parsed); needs the accessibility bus

name: WinGetText
mechanism: AT-SPI: walk descendants (max 1000 each), collect AbstractText/name, join with newline
limitations: Documented as taking 0-3 s; hidden text not included; requires accessibility enabled in the app

name: WinGetTitle
mechanism: libxdo window.name (WM_NAME/_NET_WM_NAME)
limitations: Empty string when no match

name: WinGetClass
mechanism: libxdo window.class_name (WM_CLASS)
limitations: Comment in code notes X11 class vs class_name confusion (win-get-class.cr:10)

name: PixelGetColor
mechanism: GDK: Gdk.pixbuf_get_from_window(root window, 1x1) then decode BGR/RGB
limitations: Not a direct XGetImage call (GDK wraps it); requires DISPLAY; ErrorLevel 0/1; single pixel only

name: CoordMode
mechanism: Per-thread CoordMode enums for tooltip/pixel/mouse/caret/menu
limitations: Relative mode is relative to the ACTIVE window, not the last found window (win-util.cr:82-89)

name: GuiControl
mechanism: Sets text/state on the GTK widget of a v-variable: CheckButton, TextView, Button, Label, Entry, ListBox, EventBox(picture)
limitations: Only the empty sub-command exists (gui-control.cr:14-66); Text/Move/Focus/Disable/Hide/Choose/Enable are not implemented and other widget types raise (line 64)

name: ControlGetPos
mechanism: AT-SPI get_pos: screen extents minus window origin
limitations: Needs accessibility; empty outputs on failure (control-get-pos.cr:31-36)

name: ControlGetText
mechanism: AT-SPI AbstractText, falling back to accessible name
limitations: Text may be empty for apps without accessibility

name: WinGet
mechanism: id/pid/processname (ps -p)/controllist (AT-SPI interactive descendants); Count and List produce numbered variables
limitations: No MinMax/Transparent/AlwaysOnTop/ClassNN/ControlGet; processname shells out

name: Input
mechanism: Key listener buffer with options b/c/i/l/t/v/*; EndKeys and MatchList; sets ErrorLevel (EndKey:/Match/Max/Timeout)
limitations: The visible flag only decides whether the keyboard is grabbed, no input window is shown (input.cr:46-48,103-105); L option is the buffer length

name: Loop (parse a string)
mechanism: Splits InputVar on a character class regex; OmitChars stripped by regex; A_LoopField per iteration
limitations: FutureUse argument ignored; delimiters are single characters only

name: ToolTip
mechanism: One GTK Popup window per WhichToolTip id, Tooltip type hint, keep_above, positioned at x/y or the mouse
limitations: Text update occasionally fails with a nil child and is only logged (tooltip.cr:16-23); no font/color/width options; CoordMode ToolTip honored

name: If var [not] in/contains MatchList
mechanism: Comma list with ",," escaping, case-insensitive
limitations: IfContains/IfNotContains are inverted: they test whether a list element contains the variable, not the reverse (if-contains.cr:9)

name: ControlSetText
mechanism: AT-SPI EditableText text_contents=
limitations: Only editable widgets; silently fails (ErrorLevel 1) when not editable

name: PixelSearch
mechanism: GDK pixbuf of the region, row-major scan, per-channel variation, RGB flag
limitations: Very slow for large regions; hard-codes error 2 for unexpected pixbuf format; no fast path

name: #Include
mechanism: Parser reads the file line by line and recurses; #IncludeAgain skips the dedup set
limitations: Relative to the CWD, not the script dir (parser.cr:96); no variables in the path

name: InputBox
mechanism: GTK Window + Entry + OK/Cancel, optional password visibility, timeout, default text
limitations: The Font parameter (arg 9) is dropped (input-box.cr:7); ErrorLevel 0/1/2 = OK/Cancel/Timeout; no multi-line

name: ClipWait
mechanism: Exponential backoff polling of the GTK clipboard text
limitations: Polls text only (no file/image clipboard formats)

name: EnvSet
mechanism: ENV[name] = value
limitations: Affects the AHK process and its children only

name: SetKeyDelay
mechanism: Thread settings key_delay / key_press_duration, used by Send and ControlSend
limitations: Per-thread; Sleep-based, so fractional ms allowed

name: SetMouseDelay
mechanism: Thread setting mouse_delay used by MouseClick/MouseMove
limitations: Only applied between clicks and after moves

name: MouseClickDrag
mechanism: Two MouseClick.parse_run calls: press at x1,y1 then release at x2,y2
limitations: No speed/step interpolation (same libxdo limitation)

name: #NoTrayIcon
mechanism: RunnerSettings#no_tray_icon; the StatusIcon is created but not shown
limitations: The icon object still exists (gtk.cr:266)

name: TrayTip
mechanism: libnotify Notify::Notification; icon names from Options 1/2/3; Seconds -> timeout
limitations: Requires a notification daemon; no click callbacks

name: Random
mechanism: Crystal Random.rand(min..max), int or float
limitations: New Random per call; min > max raises

name: Shutdown
mechanism: Shells out to session-manager/logout/halt/reboot chains (gnome/mate/xfce/loginctl, sudo/pkexec/gksu)
limitations: Distro-specific command chain (shutdown.cr:8-16); most modes need privileges; codes 3/7 unimplemented

name: RunAs
mechanism: Stores user/password in RunnerSettings; Run then uses "su --login" with xhost si:localuser grants
limitations: Only affects subsequent Run/RunWait; no Domain handling; password passed on the command line to su

name: SoundGet
mechanism: Parses "amixer get Master" output (on/off or Left channel volume)
limitations: Master only; ComponentType/DeviceNumber ignored; requires amixer (ALSA)

name: SoundSet
mechanism: amixer sset Master with %, mute/unmute/toggle, +/- relative
limitations: Master only; no per-component control; requires amixer

name: SoundPlay
mechanism: Player ladder ffplay > cvlc > paplay > mpg123 > aplay, first found on PATH; kills the previous PID
limitations: No device/volume control; kills any previous SoundPlay (sound-play.cr:7-9); pid killed again at exit (runner.cr:114-119)

name: Sort
mechanism: Split/join around a delimiter char, Crystal sort; options D,C,N,P,R,Random,Z
limitations: Leaves a debug "puts \"sort iter\"" inside the comparator (sort.cr:38); no logical/CL/vine sorting

name: StringTrimLeft
mechanism: Substring from Count
limitations: Count < 1 leaves text unchanged

name: StringTrimRight
mechanism: Substring to size-count-1
limitations: Count < 1 leaves text unchanged

name: WinMinimizeAll
mechanism: X11 client message _NET_SHOWING_DESKTOP = 1 to the root window
limitations: Depends on the WM supporting show-desktop; no per-window undo state

name: WinMinimizeAllUndo
mechanism: Same client message with 0
limitations: Same WM dependency

name: WinSetTitle
mechanism: libxdo window["WM_NAME"] = title
limitations: Does not update _NET_WM_NAME, so some WMs/taskbars keep the old title

name: WinWait
mechanism: Exponential backoff (20 ms..0.8 s) polling the window search; Seconds=0 means 0.5 s
limitations: Timeout only; ErrorLevel 0/1

name: WinWaitClose
mechanism: Polls until the matched window's name becomes nil (window gone)
limitations: Relies on libxdo returning nil for dead windows

name: WinWaitActive
mechanism: Polls the window search and compares to xdo active_window
limitations: No focus-stealing-prevention handling

name: WinWaitNotActive
mechanism: Inverse polling of WinWaitActive
limitations: Same

name: DriveSpaceFree
mechanism: df -Pm <path> then awk column 4
limitations: Shell-out (needs coreutils/awk); MB only; strips single quotes from the path

name: FileGetSize
mechanism: File#info.size with K/M units; falls back to the current Loop,Read file
limitations: On the success path run() returns the result of set_user_var (Bytes), and Thread raises "Result should be String for ErrorLevel command??" (thread.cr:177), so only the failure path is sane; its test is disabled (tests.ahk:318). Evident from code; not runtime-verified

name: FileRecycle
mechanism: Spawns "gio trash <path>" per glob match
limitations: No wait on gio; trash support depends on gio

name: FileRecycleEmpty
mechanism: rm -rf ${XDG_DATA_HOME:-~/.local/share}/Trash/*
limitations: DriveLetter argument ignored; permanently deletes, no prompt

name: SplitPath
mechanism: Path#basename/dirname/extension/stem into the four output variables
limitations: The fifth output (OutDrive) is never set; only 4 set_user_var calls (split-path.cr:7-10)

name: StringSplit
mechanism: Regex character class split, optional OmitChars strip; writes Array0..N
limitations: Delimiters are single characters; no CSV mode; output variable names Case-sensitive

name: Transform
mechanism: Large case: Asc/Chr/Deref/Mod/Pow/Exp/Sqrt/Log/Ln/Round/Ceil/Floor/Abs/Sin/Cos/Tan/Asin/Acos/Atan/BitNot/And/Or/Xor/ShiftLeft/ShiftRight
limitations: Transform Unicode and Transform HTML raise "Unimplemented" (transform.cr:15,25)

name: Echo
mechanism: puts to stdout (AHK_X11 only)
limitations: Not part of v1; stdout only, no file target

name: ahk_x11_print_vars
mechanism: prints the user-variable hash (debug helper, marked TODO remove once ListVars exists)
limitations: Dumps raw Bytes values; debug-only

name: FileRead
mechanism: File.read of the whole file
limitations: No binary/encoding handling; no reading to a line

name: RegExGetPos
mechanism: Crystal PCRE Regex with IGNORE_CASE; index/rindex
limitations: Always case-insensitive (no case-sensitive option); L#/R# only accepts 1/r

name: RegExReplace
mechanism: Regex#sub / #gsub with Crystal replacement syntax
limitations: Always IGNORE_CASE; ErrorLevel is 0/1 not count; replacement backreferences are Crystal's, not AHK's $1 rules

name: EnvGet
mechanism: ENV[name] lookup, empty string when unset
limitations: No #NoEnv interplay (it is always as if #NoEnv)

name: Click
mechanism: Parses "L/R/M/WheelUp/... [down|up] [x y] [count]" into MouseClick.parse_run
limitations: Relative "rel" is noted in code as crashing hahk (click.cr:18)

name: Eval
mechanism: Feeds the string back through Builder#build and starts a new thread
limitations: Very slow (re-parses; README says ~10x slower); nested heredoc quoting limits

name: ahk_x11_track_performance_start
mechanism: Sets a thread setting that makes Thread#do_next time each command
limitations: Per-thread only; overhead added while on

name: ahk_x11_track_performance_stop
mechanism: Prints sorted per-command counts and totals, then resets
limitations: Output format is Crystal pp, not the format shown in the README

name: #DefineCommand
mechanism: Parser maps a command name to a label; each argument becomes A_Param1..N around a GoSub
limitations: Arguments are plain strings; no return value; recursion/shadowing unchecked

name: DllCall
mechanism: Crystal::Loader (dlopen) + Crystal::FFI::CallInterface (libffi) at runtime
limitations: All variables are strings, so typed args are serialized Bytes; needs writable slices; the loader shells out to "cc" (hacks.cr:78); returns -2/-3/-4 for missing var/library/symbol

name: VarSetCapacity
mechanism: Allocates a Bytes buffer (optionally filled) and stores it as the variable
limitations: Built for DllCall/NumGet; no negative-capacity query semantics

name: NumGet
mechanism: Reads a typed value at Offset from the variable's Bytes
limitations: Types: ptr/uptr/str/int64/int/short/char/uint64/uint/ushort/uchar/float/double; invalid type raises

name: NumPut
mechanism: Writes a typed value into the variable's Bytes at Offset (allocates 8 bytes if needed)
limitations: Same type list; can write past the buffer if Offset is large

name: EnvUpdate
mechanism: No Cmd subclass and no parser branch; an unknown first word ends in a build-time SyntaxException
limitations: N/A (documented as removed; using it is a hard parse error, not a no-op)

name: PostMessage
mechanism: No Cmd subclass (X11 has no window messages)
limitations: Using it is a hard parse error

name: RegDelete
mechanism: No Cmd subclass (no registry on Linux)
limitations: Hard parse error

name: RegRead
mechanism: No Cmd subclass
limitations: Hard parse error

name: RegWrite
mechanism: No Cmd subclass
limitations: Hard parse error

name: SendMessage
mechanism: No Cmd subclass
limitations: Hard parse error

name: #InstallKeybdHook
mechanism: No parser branch; directives are matched by literal first word
limitations: Hard parse error (unlike Win AHK, which accepts the directive)

name: #InstallMouseHook
mechanism: No parser branch
limitations: Hard parse error

name: #UseHook
mechanism: No parser branch
limitations: Hard parse error

name: Loop (registry)
mechanism: Only Endless/Count/Files/Read/Parse loop kinds exist (loop.cr)
limitations: A "Loop, Reg, ..." is parsed as a file loop with a nonsense glob

name: AutoTrim
mechanism: No parser branch; no assignment trimming anywhere (SetEnv stores raw value)

name: Hashbang support

name: Clipboard built-in variable
mechanism: Reads/writes the GTK CLIPBOARD selection; unset is emulated with an image then a temporary text round-trip
limitations: Unset path does 3 set+wait cycles and can raise "Unsetting Clipboard failed" (gtk.cr:58-97); text only

name: A_ built-in variables
mechanism: Static table plus computed values (time, screen size, script path, user/machine, idle time, ARGV 1..N)
limitations: A_TimeIdle ignores mouse movement (runner.cr:312); A_Language from LANG via a fixed LCID table; A_ExitReason absent

name: Hotkeys subsystem (receiver)
mechanism: Hotkey class: keysym+modifier-variant enumeration (incl. CapsLock/NumLock/ScrollLock/AltGr), XGrabKey or XGrabButton, ~ prefix = no grab, * wildcard variants, per-hotkey priority and max threads
limitations: No poll/evdev fallback; grab errors are logged and ignored (x11.cr:247-249); no key history; single-key hotkeys only

name: Hotstrings subsystem
mechanism: 30-char keysym buffer fed by Xtst Record events; end-char trigger or * immediate; options * b c k o p r; replay of backspaces via x_do.keys
limitations: ? option not parsed; C1 "conform case" is a TODO (hotstring.cr:12); buffer wraps at 30 chars (hotstrings.cr:59)

name: Thread model
mechanism: Cooperative pseudo-threads: priority-sorted array, one "current" thread, resume/interrupt only between commands; per-thread ThreadSettings (CoordMode, delays, last found window, msgbox response)
limitations: No preemption: a Sleep runs in the background while another thread takes over; priority is an Int32 compared in add_thread

name: Window search / last found window
mechanism: libxdo search with require_all, only_visible, desktop; window_name or window_class match; ahk_id; "A" = active; WinText/ExcludeText filtered through AT-SPI text; last found window stored per thread
limitations: Title match is libxdo's leading-substring regex (win-util.cr:37-40); ahk_class not partial; WinText requires accessibility; each match issues an extra focused_window call as a WM workaround (win-util.cr:70-74)

name: Controls / accessibility
mechanism: AT-SPI over D-Bus: app by pid, top-level by title or size, ClassNN forged as <role>_<child indexes>, text via AbstractText, write via EditableText, click via Action names list or Selection, geometry via screen extents minus window origin
limitations: No XID correlation for the accessible tree (at-spi.cr:41); traversal is slow and capped at 1000 children; 5 retries 600 ms apart; needs libatspi + apps with accessibility on

name: GUI subsystem
mechanism: GTK3 on one dedicated worker thread; all widget access marshalled through Gtk.act (idle_add + Channel); windows kept in a gui_id table
limitations: GTK main loop must be the only widget thread; GC is disabled during act; gui ids are strings with "1" as default

name: Screen subsystem (pixels)
mechanism: GDK capture of the root window (pixbuf), then manual channel extraction; CoordMode Pixel relative to the active window
limitations: Not XGetImage directly; requires a running display; PixelSearch is a naive per-pixel loop

name: Sound subsystem
mechanism: amixer for volume/mute; player ladder (ffplay/cvlc/paplay/mpg123/aplay) for SoundPlay
limitations: ALSA-only Master channel; no PulseAudio/PipeWire native API; requires amixer/players on PATH

name: Files and INI subsystem
mechanism: Crystal File/Dir/Path for read/append/copy/delete/size/time/attrib; ini shard for IniRead/Write/Delete; gio trash for FileRecycle
limitations: No recursive dir ops, no FileGetTime/Attrib/Version, INI rewrites lose comments; all paths are real POSIX paths

name: Processes and environment
mechanism: Process.new(shell: true) with optional setsid, Gio URI launch, xdg-open fallback, su --login for RunAs; ENV for EnvGet/EnvSet; shutdown via shell chains
limitations: Everything goes through a shell (no argv exec of scripts), env changes are process-local, GUI apps inherit a scrubbed GTK env (run.cr:58-66)

name: DllCall / FFI layer
mechanism: Crystal::Loader.dlopen + Crystal::FFI::CallInterface (libffi) with 12 scalar types and pointer coercion
limitations: Variables are strings; typed params are re-serialized; read-only slices are copied; library must be loadable and the process needs "cc" for the loader's search path (hacks.cr:66-78)

name: Binary variables (NumGet/NumPut/VarSetCapacity)
mechanism: User variables are Bytes; these commands reinterpret them as typed memory
limitations: Every value is otherwise a String, so binary data round-trips through text conversions

name: Build / parse / link
mechanism: Parser builds Cmd instances from lines (command name -> subclass by class name), Linker turns if/loop/braces into a linked list, Runner#run starts the auto-execute section
limitations: Command names are derived from class names; unsupported syntax is a SyntaxException with a line number; no expression parser (legacy syntax only)

name: Script compilation
mechanism: Copies the running binary, appends the script text, the "AHK_SOUR" trailer and the original binary size; on start the binary seeks and reads it back
limitations: Portability depends on running inside an AppImage; without it the output is not portable (compiler.cr:14-16)

name: REPL
mechanism: After the auto-execute section (or with --repl) reads lines and evals each in a new thread
limitations: No multi-line input; each line is a new thread so ErrorLevel/variables from previous lines are not shared

name: Window Spy
mechanism: --windowspy runs the embedded src/window-spy.ahk through the normal interpreter; tray menu item launches it as a child process
limitations: A pure AHK script, so it inherits every limitation of the commands it uses (AT-SPI text, GDK pixel)

name: Graphical installer
mechanism: With no script argument and no stdin it runs the embedded src/installer.ahk
limitations: Installer is itself an AHK script; writes a desktop file and copies the AppImage

name: Packaging / distribution
mechanism: AppImage built in Ubuntu 20.04 with linuxdeploy; Makefile targets; release.sh; Alpine Dockerfile for headless GVfs/VNC use
limitations: AppImage is the only supported portable form; xdotool is a git submodule and the tree expects a patched fork (win-util.cr:26-27)

name: Display-adapter abstraction
mechanism: Abstract class with initialize/run/grab_hotkey/ungrab_hotkey/block_input/unblock_input; single implementation Run::X11
limitations: There is only one adapter; Run::Gtk and Run::AtSpi are separate classes, not adapters, so a Wayland adapter would not fit the existing interface (no pointer/screen/window methods)
